title: FREE REQUEST Looking for Character Sprite Artist

posts.author: Solarae
posts.body:
I’m currently working on an RPG Maker MV game called
Dark Hearted
, inspired by classic Final Fantasy with a strong story focus, turn-based combat, and character-driven progression.
I’m a solo developer handling everything myself right now: story, design, systems, and overall development. I will also publish it on Steam in the future.
What I’ll be needing:
Sprites for the 4 main party characters.
(including idle, walking, battle, and basic animations)
Around 10 additional NPCs. (Inn Keeper, Shop Keeper, Townsfolk, etc)
Consistent pixel-art style that is inspired by classic FF games like FFV or FFVI.
Right now, the project is still in the early development stage.
I have updates on the game
here on KOFI
, but as of now, due to the stage it is in, not much has been uploaded. I plan on uploading more info in a month. I have an RPGMaker03 Version on my KOFI if anyone is interested in what the game is about (it's a super short game, but shows the basics of the story).
